text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Nations observers issue report on Algeria's general election. Opposition parties had contested the poll's fairness.
- The first plural National Assembly holds a first session on June 15.
- Britain arrests three Moslem activists on charge of backing "terrorism".

- President Liamine Zeroual is to rename Ahmed Ouyahia as the head of the next government. National Democratic Rally (RND) party heads for an alliance with the National Liberation Front (FLN) in order to form a majority in the lower house.
- Opposition parties await the Constitutional Council to rule on poll irregularities.
- Zeroual says the Thursday poll victory was an incentive to complete the election process in the country by holding local elections.
- The Constitutional Council will made a statement on the election official results today.
